name: Robert F. Glass
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: Mercer University Walter F. George School of Law
about: Robert F. Glass is a partner at Glass & Robson, LLC, a premier plaintiff’s personal injury firm based in Atlanta, Georgia. Robert is widely recognized throughout the state as one of the most accomplished plaintiff lawyers in Georgia. Robert is known for his professionalism, determined work ethic, dedication to his clients, extensive and thorough preparation in litigation, and excellence in the courtroom. Robert holds an “AV” Preeminent Rating from Martindale Hubbell. Robert’s advocacy has earned him inclusion in Thomson Reuters’ Georgia Super Lawyers Rising Star and Super Lawyers every year since 2011. In 2021, Robert was nominated for and accepted to the prestigious Best Lawyers in America organization and has been nominated every year since. In 2025, Robert was named one of Georgia's Top 100 Super Lawyers for the first time.

Robert’s practice focuses on all variations of serious injury and wrongful death matters. He frequently litigates and tries cases arising from serious motor vehicle collisions, tractor-trailer collisions, and serious premises liability matters. Robert frequently speaks and presents on various personal injury litigation and trial subjects based on his past success.

Robert is actively involved in various legal organizations, including the State Bar of Georgia, Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, and American Board of Trial Advocates (“ABOTA”). Robert is a leader within the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, serving as a member of its Executive Committee and chair of the Georgia Civil Justice PAC. Robert was nominated and accepted to the American Board of Trial Advocates in 2022 and serves as the organization’s Southeast Chapter’s treasurer.

Robert is an Atlanta native. He graduated magna cum laude from the University of the South in 2002. Robert obtained his law degree from Mercer University’s Walter F. George School of Law, cum laude , where he served as Senior Managing Editor of the Mercer Law Review , a member of the moot court board, and was elected by the entire student body as Honor Court Prosecutor during his third year.

In his spare time, Robert enjoys spending time with his wife and three children. Robert is an avid outdoorsman, having completed a semester course with the National Outdoor Leadership School (NOLS) in Alaska in 2002, an experience he credits to his work ethic and success. Robert is also an award-winning western, big-game archery and mountain hunter.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
